描述_ZN: The Wild Duck in the Stream, Song Dynasty, on silk with color, 26.4 cm in length and 27 cm in width.　　There is no mark on this painting. Inscriptions of "True Appreciation", "Genuine Song and Yuan Dynasty Works in the Collection of Pang Lai-chen", "Precious Secret", "Changyi Zishu", "Gong", "Precious Appreciation of Xinguang", and "Precious Secret of Xinguang", "Gong", "Precious Appreciation of Duke Xinguang", "Collection of Huaihou", "Dancheng", and "Chapter of the Painting and Calligraphy of Duke Geng Xinguang". Inscription on the edge of the frame reads "Collection of the Noble Lord".　　The picture depicts reeds and mizuna growing by the stream, with lush branches and leaves. The male duck is standing on one foot on the shore taking a nap; the female duck is looking back at the water and combing her feathers, with a leisurely posture and graceful demeanor. This picture is intended to express a peaceful and stable atmosphere, and should be the work of the Southern Song Painting Institute to embellish the rising and leveling. The composition is mature and concise, with the middle left of the picture shaded by reeds, giving a sense of security; the upper right leaves a piece of water to inspire people's thoughts, so as not to be closed. The coloring is fine and realistic, and the expression of the male duck feathers is particularly impressive. Although the color has been dark old, can still imagine the glittering glory of the state.　　The opposite panel is inscribed by Geng Zhaozhong: "Huang Youshu's picture of a duck and a bamboo is very precious to me, and the spirit of this page is all in harmony. Painting things up to this point, deep into the three mysteries. Zhaozhong knows." 　　The "famous brush collection of victory" in the book. Recorded in "Xuzhai famous paintings".
